workflow_data.question:
What's one tradition or ritual — from anywhere in your life — that you'd want
more of in the communities you're part of, and what is it about that practice
that makes it valuable to you?
workflow_data.context:
This is a smoke test for the controller/adapter refactor. Keep the
conversation short — the goal is just to exercise the full flow: opening
turn, a couple of conversational turns (text and voice), the
[READY_FOR_PERMISSIONS] transition, the per-point permissions walk-through,
the addition prompt (try both yes and no paths across runs), and final
completion.
